Hot Cold Cognition is an educational framework developed at the University of British Columbia to help students better understand and develop their learning skills. The framework emphasizes the importance of taking initiative and developing self-directed learning habits. It is based on the principles of cognitive psychology and aims to equip students with skills that they can use both during and beyond their studies.
